title: database-modeling-skill Output
description: Output summary for Prisma_Schema_Proposal.prisma and DB_Schema.sql

prisma_schema_path.description: Path to the written Prisma_Schema_Proposal.prisma file.

db_schema_path.description: Path to the written DB_Schema.sql file.

all_entities_covered.description: True only if every domain entity in Architecture.md has a corresponding Prisma model.

missing_entities.description: Domain entities from Architecture.md without a Prisma model. Must be empty.

pii_field_count.description: Number of fields annotated with @privacy: PII or @privacy: PII_SENSITIVE.

unclassified_pii_fields.description: Fields suspected to be PII but missing privacy annotation (e.g., 'email', 'phone', 'name'). Must be empty.

naming_convention_compliant.description: True when all models have @@map (snake_case table) and all fields have @map (snake_case column).

relations_with_explicit_on_delete.description: True when every @relation has explicit onDelete behavior.

models_missing_timestamps.description: Model names missing createdAt or updatedAt. Acceptable only for pure junction tables.

data_classification_path.description: Path to the data classification section written (in Security_Strategy.md or standalone Data_Classification.md).

migration_risk_notes.description: Brief note on migration risk for migration-risk-analysis-skill to consume. E.g., 'New tables only — no destructive changes'.
